description: DOE Global Energy Storage Database is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The DOE Global Energy Storage Database provides research-grade information on grid-connected energy storage projects and relevant state and federal policies. All data can be exported to Excel or JSON format. As of September 22, 2023, this page serves as the official hub for The Global Energy Storage Database. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are energy storage. The portal shows 2024-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Sandia National Laboratory Terms of Use (https://gesdb.sandia.gov/terms-of-use.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
